name: @treeseed/market
description: TreeSeed marketplace site built on top of @treeseed/core.

scripts.bootstrap: if test -f ./packages/core/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.ts; then node ./packages/core/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/core/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.js; else treeseed starlight:patch; fi
scripts.dev:web: if test -f ./packages/core/scripts/dev-platform.ts; then node ./packages/core/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/core/scripts/dev-platform.ts --surface web; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/dev-platform.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/dev-platform.js --surface web; else echo 'Unable to resolve @treeseed/core dev-platform entrypoint.'; exit 1; fi
scripts.dev:api: if test -f ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs; then node ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/agent/src/api/server.ts; else treeseed-agent-api dev; fi
scripts.dev:workday-manager: if test -f ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs; then node ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/agent/src/services/workday-manager.ts; else treeseed-agent-service workday-manager; fi
scripts.dev:worker-runner: if test -f ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs; then node ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/agent/src/services/worker.ts; else treeseed-agent-service worker; fi
scripts.dev:agents: if test -f ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs; then node ./packages/agent/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/agent/src/services/agents.ts; else treeseed-agent-service agents; fi
scripts.check: if test -f ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant-check.ts; then node ./packages/sdk/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant-check.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant-check.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant-check.js; else treeseed check; fi
scripts.build:web: if test -f ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant-build.ts; then TREESEED_LOCAL_DEV_MODE=cloudflare node ./packages/sdk/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant-build.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant-build.js; then TREESEED_LOCAL_DEV_MODE=cloudflare node ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant-build.js; else TREESEED_LOCAL_DEV_MODE=cloudflare treeseed build; fi
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.preview: if test -f ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant-astro-command.ts; then node ./packages/sdk/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/sdk/scripts/tenant-astro-command.ts preview; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant-astro-command.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/sdk/dist/scripts/tenant-astro-command.js preview; else treeseed preview; fi
scripts.verify:direct: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.processing:parity-plan: docker run --rm --env-file $(test -f .env.local.processing && echo .env.local.processing || echo .env.local.processing.example) treeseed-processing:local parity-plan --environment local
scripts.test:processing-parity-staging: TREESEED_ENVIRONMENT=staging TREESEED_DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT=staging npm -w packages/agent run test:processing-local
